Ukrainian student teachers and practitioners are aware of the existence of the social dimension of the information gap technique but they do not fully understand its potential and are not sure of how to use the information gap technique to develop social skills in English language learners.

Ukrainian pre service student teachers and practitioner in service teachers still have to be better informed of the term, of the types of information gap activity tasks, and of the social dimension of their use.

1. The majority of the teachers do not have a clear idea of the meaning of the Information Gap activities; 2. The teachers do not know the main principles of the Information Gap tasks design and arrangement;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a set of information gap tasks designed for teaching English to Ukrainian students.
the exploration of the information gap technique in English language teaching.
the social content of information gaps and the way they can be used in the English classroom to develop the social skills of English language learners.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the information gap technique has a great potential for the development of social skills of the students, but it is still not sufficiently explored and applied by the teachers.
the information gap technique has a great potential for developing social skills, and that the technique should be used in the classroom more often.
information gap activities have the potential for developing the students' social skills in English language classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the information gap technique is a powerful and versatile tool for developing social competence of English language learners.
the information gap technique is a very promising tool for developing social skills in the English classroom.
information gap technique is a valuable tool for developing social skills in the English classroom.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social content of information gaps can be successfully used in the English classroom to enhance the development of the social competence of the English language students.
